protocol.generation: random.Random(seed); angle uniform(0,2*pi), radius sqrt(uniform(60**2,180**2)), heading uniform(0,2*pi); center=(600,300)
protocol.primary_metric: food arrivals / all cases; paired by case for both control comparisons
secondary_metrics: success-only time and path efficiency with denominators
protocol.validation_gate: trained arrivals >=13/16 and strictly above both controls; else stop with no final evaluation
protocol.final_gate: trained arrivals >=26/32 and at least 8 more arrivals than each control; for each paired comparison require one-sided exact discordant-pair binomial p<=0.025
protocol.paired_p_definition: For w cases with trained success/control failure and l with trained failure/control success, n=w+l; p=sum(comb(n,k) for k=w..n)/2**n, or 1 if n=0. Two comparisons use Bonferroni .025 each.
protocol.stop_rule: Any numerical/contract mismatch aborts; failed validation closes evaluation without final; failed final closes candidate. No tuning, retraining, gain changes, or case replacement.
protocol.limit: Same arena, odor source, annular starts, frozen network seed and software/device. No claim about zero-odor exploration, other environments, biological fidelity or topology benefit.
